text: Nothing file needs organism database. Leave organism ref_build , use gene ids rownames counts. changes app can offer: KEGG tabs appear human, mouse, rat. GO tile plots GO heatmap appear rowdata GO annotation columns: GO BP, GO MF, GO CC, holding "; "-separated GO ids (NA none). One ontology enough. ORA / GSEA show results pass pathways; app never runs enrichment . annotation one list GO ids per gene (e.g. eggNOG-mapper’s comma-separated GOs column), split ontology GO.db: pathway results, run clusterProfiler’s enricher() (GSEA()) TERM2GENE built annotation. example shipped dataset annotation package: keeps GO BP column, builds TERM2GENE , runs ORA -regulated genes tested ones. Gene ids TERM2GENE must rownames counts. Name nested results app shows : ontology (BP, MF, CC, label), direction (upGenes, downGenes, bothGenes).
code: # annot: one row per gene, with gene_id and GOs ("GO:0008150,GO:0003674", or "-") ids  <- strsplit(annot$GOs, ",", fixed = TRUE) long <- data.frame(gene_id = rep(annot$gene_id, lengths(ids)), go = unlist(ids)) long <- long[grepl("^GO:", long$go), ] long$ontology <- AnnotationDbi::Ontology(long$go)   # "BP", "MF" or "CC" for (ont in c("BP", "MF", "CC")) {   hits     <- long[long$ontology %in% ont, ]   per_gene <- split(hits$go, factor(hits$gene_id, levels = annot$gene_id))   annot[[paste("GO", ont)]] <- vapply(per_gene, function(x)     if (length(x)) paste(x, collapse = "; ") else NA_character_, "") } rd  <- rowData(se) bp  <- strsplit(as.character(rd[["GO BP"]]), "; ", fixed = TRUE) t2g <- data.frame(term = unlist(bp), gene = rep(rownames(rd), lengths(bp))) t2g <- t2g[!is.na(t2g$term), ]  tested <- rownames(rd)[rd$usedInTest] up     <- rownames(rd)[rd$usedInTest & !is.na(rd$fdr) & rd$fdr < 0.05 & rd$log2Ratio > 0] ora_up <- clusterProfiler::enricher(up, TERM2GENE = t2g, universe = tested)  build_explore_h5ad(   x        = list(counts = assay(se, "counts"), normalised = assay(se, "xNorm")),   out      = file.path(out_dir, "own_annotation.h5ad"),   omics    = "rnaseq",   coldata  = colData(se),   rowdata  = rd[, c("gene_id", "gene_name", "description", "GO BP")],   factors  = "Condition [Factor]",   de       = list(diff_vs_undiff = rd),   pathways = list(diff_vs_undiff = list(ora = list(BP = list(upGenes = ora_up)))) )
